text:
alex: Heads up — noticing a cluster-wide uptick in NVIDIA Xid 13 and 31 on several A10 cards in eu-west1. Start ~6h ago, steady increase. p95 latency for embedder ops up and some failed decodes. :eyes:

maria: Where are you seeing it? specific racks/hosts? any tenant skew?

alex: Mostly rack euw-az2-rack23, hosts host-2304..2308. Quick cohort look shows >70% of Xids associated with the embedder tenant `tenant_embed_v2` and small-batch requests (batch_size <= 4).

tim: Can you paste the GPU driver logs? also need `nvidia-smi -q` and ECC counters.

alex: pasted snippet below from host-2306 logs: 

```
[2026-03-17T02:14:22Z] nvidia: Xid (13) Decode error, class 0x82
[2026-03-17T02:14:22Z] kernel: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU reported ECC error (corrected)
[2026-03-17T02:14:23Z] nvidia: Xid (31) Channel exception on copy engine 2
[2026-03-17T02:15:05Z] runtime: lost context on device 0, resetting
```

+ tiny `nvidia-smi -q` excerpt: `ECC Errors Volatile: 23 (last 24h)` for device 0 on host-2306.

olivia: Curious — tenant_embed_v2 started a config change last night to enable aggressive KV-cache sharing + continuous short requests. Could be memory pressure pattern exposing a flaky card.

maria: If ECC corrected counts are increasing, that points to memory flippage; Xid13 often aligns with memory error during decode, Xid31 is channel/driver level. Need to triage whether this is hardware vs. workload-induced.

tim: Quick triage plan: 1) pull full `dmesg` and GPU telemetry, 2) test repro by running the same small-batch embedding workload on an isolated host, 3) soft-drain suspect card and schedule replacement if repro or persistent ECC growth.

alex: Agreed. I'll run isolation test on host-2306 and start capturing perf counters. If repro, we should priority-drain the card.

olivia: Also add a filter to the infra alerting to correlate Xid spikes to tenant id and batch size (we should be able to tag metrics by tenant). Right now alerts are per-host only.

maria: For immediate mitigation, can we route tenant_embed_v2 to other racks (euw-az2-rack12/13) for the next 2 hours while we investigate? We should avoid broad cold-start cost.

tim: I can create a routing rule in the runtime to pin that tenant to alternate racks for 2h. Will start rollout as a canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

alex: Please annotate the rollout with `#reason:Xid13-31-euw-host2306` in the changelog. Also we should capture a sample request that triggers the failure to upload to the eval harness.

deploy-bot: Started ephemeral routing rollout for tenant_embed_v2: canary 10% -> 50% (triggered by @tim)

oncall-bot: Remind: if ECC corrected counts exceed 50 in 24h or Xid rate > 1/min on device -> escalate to hw-replacement procedure.

olivia: Cost note — moving high-volume embedder off the potentially flaky rack increases cross-rack NIC egress for a subset of traffic. Estimate ~8% token-cost bump while rerouting; discuss if we want to keep it long term vs replace card.

maria: If the isolation repro fails (no Xids), that points to transient hardware/environment. Still schedule replacement next maintenance window if volatile ECC remains.

tim: Running isolation now — will post results in ~15m. If we see immediate repro, I will soft-drain `GPU 0` on host-2306 and kick off replacement ticket.

alex: Thanks. Also log the tenant dev contact (cc @olivia) so they can roll back last-night KV-cache change if we confirm correlation.

olivia: noted. tagging infra-runbook: `gpu/xid-triage` and adding a short checklist: capture logs, isolate workload, run `memtest` on GPU, soft-drain, escalate to replace.

maria: One more action: export recent traces for `decode` ops into S3 under `sre/xid-triage/1769998888/` for later root-cause and postmortem.

alex: done — uploaded traces and added link: https://s3.redwood.internal/sre/xid-triage/1769998888/trace.tar.gz

tim: isolation run result: reproduced Xid13 within 3 iterations on host-2306 using the tenant_embed_v2 small-batch harness. I'm proceeding with soft-drain of GPU 0 now.

deploy-bot: Soft-drain initiated on host-2306 GPU 0 (requested by @tim). Active allocations will be gracefully migrated.

olivia: After migration, please run `nvidia-pci-rescan` + `gpu-memtest` to see if errors persist. If persistent, open RMA/replace with vendor.

maria: Adding to incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5423 (Xid13/31 eu-west1 A10 cohort)

alex: Moving to follow-up: schedule hardware replacement if device shows >50 corrected ECC in next 24h or Xid rate doesn't drop after reroute.

tim: will update thread after replacement decision.

olivia: thanks team — nice rapid triage. :thumbsup:
